title: What we're thankful for (Thanksgiving)
parts:
🦃 WHAT WE'RE THANKFUL FOR

Six waiver adds and later-round picks who helped carry teams to title week.

FP/G and position ranks: Fantrax, thru Week 12, FBS players with 6+ games. Board ranks (#): full Alpha Draft Signal board, all classes, thru Wk 11.

Receipts 👇

🏃 Cole Tabb, RB, Cincinnati | WAIVER ADD

We flagged him Oct 20 at 47% rostered. He's at 86% now.

Since then: 31.9 FP/G over 5 games, capped by 54.0 vs Colorado, the top line of Week 12.
His carry share: 29% on the season, 38% over his last 4.

RB5 at 26.3 FP/G.

🙌 Jesse Legree, WR, Oregon State (FR) | WAIVER ADD

Undrafted in a 12-team, 20-round Fantrax draft. Preseason WR #1,029, now #19.

WR4 at 28.1 FP/G. 1,418 yds, 15 TD, 35% of the Beavers' rec yds. Best: 47.1 vs SDSU.

Not our waiver call. Our must-start by Oct 16.

🎯 Marcus Stokes, QB, Memphis | LATE-ROUND PICK

Went in round 13 of that same Fantrax draft. Preseason QB #597, now #54.

QB11 at 30.7 FP/G. 3,047 pass yds, 28 TD, 7 INT, 10.2 adjusted yds per attempt.
Best: 49.8 at Charlotte. Week 12 vs Navy: 9.5.

🏃 Aiden Flora, RB, Iowa State | WAIVER ADD

Undrafted in that Fantrax draft. Preseason RB #751, now #83.

RB4 at 26.9 FP/G. 1,506 rush yds, 14 TD, 7.2 per carry.
Last 4: 64% of ISU's carries, 36.7 FP/G.

We told you to sit him twice. He made us pay once.

🧱 Jelani Thurman, TE, North Carolina | WAIVER ADD

Undrafted in that Fantrax draft. Preseason TE #48, now #6.

What he's given you this season: TE6 at 18.0 FP/G. 51 rec, 610 yds, 8 TD, 23% of UNC's rec yds. Best: 30.7 vs UConn.

Left the Virginia game hurt (arm).

🙌 Jackson Harris, WR, LSU | WAIVER ADD

Undrafted in that Fantrax draft. Preseason WR #96, now #62.

What he's given you this season: WR21 at 18.7 FP/G. 57 rec, 871 yds, 9 TD, 26% of LSU's rec yds. Best: 38.8 at Auburn.

Left the Tennessee game hurt (lower leg).

Only one of these six was our waiver call. We told you to sit Flora twice, and Legree, Thurman and Harris got there without us.

That's the honest version of thankful. The wire (and round 13) paid you anyway.

Happy Thanksgiving. Who's the pickup you're thankful for? 👇
